title: Sefaria Edition
text: ויקח חמאה וגו AND HE TOOK חמאה, ETC. — but he did not bring bread, on account of Sarah becoming mentstruant; as the 'way of women' returned to her that day, and the dough became impure (Bava Metzia 87a).
חדל להיות means [that] it had ceased from her.
אורח כנשים means the way of menstruation.
